description: This file contains a suite of unit tests for the LocationService class in the OpenMRS API project. It includes tests for creating, updating, retrieving, retiring, unretiring, and deleting Location and LocationTag objects, as well as their attributes and related entities. The tests verify the correct behavior of LocationService methods, including handling of hierarchical locations, tagging, attribute management, and global property influence.

classes.name: LocationServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the behavior of LocationService methods in the OpenMRS API, covering CRUD operations, tags, attributes, hierarchical locations, retirements, and global property effects.
